name: umbra-runtime-mixed-v1

routes.matched: Both binaries use WebKit read for static HTML, fetch for JSON, and identical persistent-tab DOM/native commands.
routes.public_http: Baseline uses its read/fetch browser paths. Candidate uses its public http command only for explicitly public static HTML/JSON; DOM/native tasks remain identical. This is product routing, not a pure WebKit engine comparison.

success: Every frozen task remains in denominator. Static and JSON content must equal expected data and server must receive its unique request token. DOM task must read JS-computed total and row count. Native task requires trusted input/click events, exact field/output state and a matching successful server receipt.
claims: Raw bytes are not tokenizer counts. Whole-family physical footprint includes daemon and responsibility-associated WebKit/GPU/network processes. Throughput per GiB is descriptive; the 2x same-RAM gate additionally requires both arms within the same declared memory budget. Custom localhost tasks are regression/performance evidence, not independent agent benchmark success.
